Context: PERIOD OF PROBATION

| PROMOTION | PROMOTION | |
| 1. | Promotion from one grade to another but within the same group of posts, e.g. from Group 'C' to Group 'C' | No probation. |
| 2. | Promotion from one Group to another, e.g. Group 'B' to Group 'A' | The period of probation prescribed for the direct recruitment to the higher post. If no period is pres cribed, then it should be 2 years. |
| DIRECT RECRUITMENT | DIRECT RECRUITMENT | |
| 3. | (i) For direct recruitment to posts except Clause (ii) below | 2 years |
